运行安装包内的 Install.ps1，授权一次 UAC。安装到 Program: Run Install.ps1 from the package and approve UAC once. The app installs in Program Files and starts tray and device control at sign-in. Keep Intel, NVIDIA, Realtek, Fortemedia and Histen hardware drivers.
连接后读取当前预设。: Connect to read the current preset.
适用于内置麦克风阵列。驱动支持时可选单人、多人或周围环境音。: For the internal microphone array. Single-person, group and ambient modes require driver support.
选择目标刷新率后立即应用，保持当前分辨率。快捷键可在设置页修改。: Selecting a refresh rate applies it immediately and keeps the current resolution. Change hotkeys in Settings.
重新打开以应用语言 / Restart to apply: Restart to apply / 重新打开以应用语言
首次打开显示教程，版本升级后显示更新记录。后台登录启动不会弹出教程。: Shows the tutorial on first open and the changelog after updates. Background sign-in startup does not interrupt you.
在「性能与散热」直接选择智能、高能或 HUNTER。高能要求插电且电量至少 20: In Performance and cooling, select Smart, Performance or HUNTER. Performance needs AC and at least 20% battery; HUNTER needs barrel-jack power or at least 135 W PD. Fan presets are available in HUNTER; a supported 200 W adapter unlocks levels 4–5. The UI reads the level from firmware. RPM varies with load.
开启「自动性能模式」后，识别到游戏进程就选择供电允许的最高模式。切到桌面不降档；: Enable Automatic performance mode to select the highest available mode when a game process is recognized. Returning to the desktop keeps it active. After processes disappear, wait 45 seconds plus scene stabilization. Creative scenes use Performance; other scenes use Smart. Successful manual changes disable automatic mode. Blocked changes preserve settings and show the reason.
「进程调度」控制进程 HighQoS、EcoQoS 和少量游戏核心分配；可选择前: Process scheduling controls HighQoS, EcoQoS and selected game core affinities. Choose foreground / background apps or enable automatic recognition. OS Turbo controls EPP, DTT, fan tables and GPU offsets. HUNTER pauses EPP and keeps firmware power / fan control. The three switches can be used independently.
在「显示与色彩」选择原生、sRGB 或 P3，同时更新硬件 LUT 和 ICC。: In Display and color, Native, sRGB and P3 update both hardware LUT and ICC. ICC association alone does not change the full-screen output gamut. Public packages need local panel calibration; only internal SDR is verified. Select a target refresh rate in the dropdown. Fn+R cycles supported rates.
在「音频」分别选择外放、耳机音效与麦克风拾音。空间音频依赖 Histen，单人、: In Audio, set speaker effects, headphone effects and microphone pickup separately. Spatial audio needs Histen; single-person, group and ambient pickup need Fortemedia and the array driver. Pickup mode is separate from mute. The mute key and indicator work independently.
自动显卡策略插电保留双显卡，电池供电时等独显空闲 30 秒再尝试关闭，占用期间等: Automatic GPU policy keeps both GPUs on AC. On battery it waits for 30 seconds of discrete-GPU idle time before attempting power-off. It waits while the GPU is in use. Forcing integrated graphics can interrupt GPU tasks. Home, Office and Travel set charging start / stop thresholds; the stop threshold does not force discharge.
场景网络规则只影响出站优先标记和已识别下载器的后台上传，效果取决于网络设备。WL: Scene network rules affect outbound priority tags and recognized downloaders' background uploads. Results depend on network equipment. WLAN connects saved profiles only and pauses weak-signal switching during games / meetings. Browser download interception and phone collaboration are excluded.
关闭窗口后继续托盘常驻。Fn+P 切换固件模式，Fn+R 切换内屏刷新率；F1–: Closing the window keeps the tray active. Fn+P changes firmware mode; Fn+R changes refresh rate. Choose F1–F12 defaults and customize alternative shortcuts in Settings. This app does not show brightness / volume notifications. Exit from the tray to pause until next sign-in.
关闭对应自动控制后，按恢复记录还原本应用修改的设置。「恢复首次备份」还原首次保存: Turning off a controller restores the settings it changed using recovery records. Restore original backup restores the first saved hardware color and ICC association. Open logs from Settings in LocalAppData\HonorControl. Upgrades preserve preferences. Reopen the tutorial and changelog in About.
实机验证为 DRA-XX / BIOS 1.13 / 125H + RTX 40: Hardware testing covers DRA-XX / BIOS 1.13 / 125H + RTX 4060. Other configurations of this model need feature-specific validation. Other laptop models are unsupported even with the same CPU and GPU.
同型号不同配置: Other configurations of the same model
固件控制按 DRA-XX 与 BIOS 1.13 检查，仍需其他配置实测。DTT: Firmware checks DRA-XX and BIOS 1.13; other configurations still need testing. Scene DTT writes require 125H; NVIDIA clock offsets require RTX 4060 Laptop GPU. Selected affinity rules cover 125H and 155H. Color needs matching physical-panel calibration; audio needs compatible installed drivers and endpoints.
双击 Setup 安装程序，授权一次 UAC。安装到 Program Files: Double-click Setup and approve UAC once. Installs in Program Files and starts tray / device control at sign-in. Upgrades preserve preferences and local calibration. Keep Intel, NVIDIA, Realtek, Fortemedia and Histen hardware drivers.
上述荣耀软件服务均未检测到。下方仍列出具体名称，便于迁移其他设备时核对。: None of the listed HONOR software services were detected. Their exact names are listed below for migration checks on other devices.
荣耀电脑管家 → 管家与更新后台；OSD → 原厂功能键浮窗；HUNTERCAM: HONOR PC Manager: manager / updater. OSD: OEM function-key notifications. HUNTERCAMP: game controls. Magic Animation: animated interface service. HONOR YOYO Assistant: AI assistant / inference. Uninstall these by name in Windows Installed apps first.

HnUpdateService: HONOR software updater
OSDServer: OEM OSD
HunterCampService: HUNTERCAMP
MagicAnimationService: Magic Animation
HnPCAIService, HnPCInferEngine: AI / inference
QAXDefender.SDK: only the bundled component installed under HONOR\PCManager\qspublic.
保留 Fortemedia 的 FMAPOService、Realtek 音频服: Keep Fortemedia FMAPOService, Realtek audio services, Histen / Honor audio APOs, Awinic, Intel Smart Sound, Intel Dynamic Tuning, Intel / NVIDIA graphics, ACPI, HID and camera drivers. Do not remove drivers based only on their vendor name. Keep ProgramData\HonorEffect audio calibration.
优先使用应用卸载入口。Clean-HonorSoftware.ps1 默认只列清: Use the application's uninstaller first. Clean-HonorSoftware.ps1 previews its plan by default. After reviewing it, run as administrator with -Apply. Reports cover software folders, registrations, services, startup and packages; hardware drivers are retained. Open the installation guide in About for commands and recovery steps.
无法读取服务清单，请按下方名称在 Windows 服务和已安装的应用中核对。: Cannot read the service list. Check the names below in Windows Services and Installed apps.
日志与恢复记录保存在本机 LocalAppData\\HonorControl。: Logs and recovery records are stored locally in LocalAppData\HonorControl.
运行日志每份最多 2 MiB，每类最多 3 份，超过 14 天未更新的日志自动清: Runtime logs rotate at 2 MiB with three files per stream. Logs not updated for 14 days are removed. Preferences, recovery records and calibration backups are retained.
新增单文件安装与卸载程序、具体原厂服务迁移清单和日志自动滚动。修复拔电 Fn+P: Adds a single-file setup / uninstaller, specific OEM service migration checklist and automatic log rotation. Fixes battery Fn+P warnings, warning text alignment and tutorial centering, with Chinese / English UI and detailed usage steps.
